facts.statement: The genus Nominosuchus was described by Mikhail Efimov in 1996.
facts.quote: Nominosuchus was described in 1996 by Mikhail Efimov, and the type species is N. matutinus.

facts.statement: The type specimen of Nominosuchus is a partial skull identified as PIN 4174/4.
facts.quote: The type specimen is PIN 4174/4, a partial skull.

facts.statement: Nominosuchus was small, with an estimated skull length of 60 mm.
facts.quote: Nominosuchus was not large; its skull length is estimated at 60 mm.

facts.statement: Nominosuchus is classified as a protosuchian-grade crocodyliform.
facts.quote: Nominosuchus is a genus of protosuchian-grade crocodyliform.

facts.statement: Nominosuchus is assigned to the family Shartegosuchidae.
facts.quote: It was similar to Shartegosuchus, and is assigned to the same family (Shartegosuchidae).

facts.statement: The parent group of the genus Nominosuchus is Shartegosuchidae.
The type species of the genus Nominosuchus is N. matutinus.
There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Nominosuchus in the Paleobiology Database.

rejected.quote: Nominosuchus is known from several specimens discovered in ancient lake deposits of the Tithonian-age Upper Jurassic Ulan Malgait Formation, southwestern Mongolia.
